t: Julie Byrne: “Natural Blue” Track Review | Pitchfork
s: November 17, 2016 - On “Natural Blue,” the singer-songwriter Julie Byrne points to what is majestic in the formless and infinite. Solemn and serene, it is four minutes of collected energy, with subtle fingerpicking, weeping strings, and just Byrne’s deep voice as an anchor.
